propositions: The clean core-wheel optionality lane installs unbounded mcp, which resolves to 2.0.0, but the project supports only mcp>=1.28.1,<2
MCP 2.0 removed mcp.server.fastmcp, causing rebar imports to fail in the lane
The workflow must pin MCP to the same supported version interval as pyproject.toml to match production constraints
The lane must verify the agents extra is not installed while preserving FastMCP transport support with a compatible MCP version
